independent_checks.method: Read-only Python stdlib JSON/path/hash checks; compiler and live implementations not executed.

validation_rationality.assessment: Reasonable as explicitly scoped static checks. Budget is UTF-8 bytes of the artifact; named o200k token measurement is not an assembled host prompt guarantee. Planned readiness is distinct from runtime execution.
validation_rationality.source_window_limit: Primary source windows are excerpts plus paths/digests; hash equality alone does not prove semantic completeness. Dispatch still requires upstream materialization, current source/contract review and mandatory-context budget check.

limitations: Семантика всех остальных leaf outcomes/dependencies повторно не проверялась.
Проверка не доказывает корректность будущей SQLite authority, Fabric adapter, migrations, harness или production outcome.
Нет live host calls, foreign scripts, full suites или source repository edits.
Acceptance неизвестных material decisions и необходимость новых migration targets остаются будущим decision output; исполнение потребует новой packet revision.
